scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:app" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../app && npm install && cd ../dashboard-admin && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd server && npm run build && cd ../app && npm run build && cd ../dashboard-admin && npm run build
scripts.lint:all: cd server && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || true && cd ../app && npm run lint && cd ../dashboard-admin && npm run lint
